message:
## Vulnerability Digest

This DLL component scan used only `DLL_software_component.txt`; obvious aliases were normalized and duplicates were removed. The scan window was **2026-10-01 13:10 IST through 2026-10-02 13:10 IST** (2026-10-01 07:40 through 2026-10-02 07:40 UTC).

No credible, newly reported or materially updated vulnerability in the last 24 hours could be matched confidently to a component and version in the assigned DLL inventory.

### Findings

No relevant new vulnerabilities were confirmed in scope. Fresh disclosures found during the search affected other products or packages, and loose matches based only on a vendor, framework, or bundled-library name were excluded.

### MongoDB ecosystem verification

A dedicated sweep covered MongoDB Server Community and Enterprise, `mongod`, `mongos`, Atlas and Atlas services, Ops Manager, Cloud Manager, Compass, `mongosh`, Database Tools, Kubernetes operators, official drivers and connectors, BI Connector/SQL Interface, Charts, Realm/App Services, official integrations, MongoDB-owned alerts, GitHub advisories, CVE/NVD-oriented results, and CISA-oriented sources.

No credible MongoDB-family vulnerability was newly reported or materially updated within the exact 24-hour window. The newest authoritative MongoDB security alerts surfaced by the sweep predated this window.

### Sources checked

- [MongoDB security alerts](https://www.mongodb.com/resources/products/alerts)
- [GitHub Advisory Database](https://github.com/advisories)
- [NVD vulnerability search](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/search)
- [CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities Catalog](https://www.cisa.gov/known-exploited-vulnerabilities-catalog)

### Review priority

No immediate vulnerability review is recommended from this scan. Continue routine monitoring; reassess promptly if a vendor advisory later maps a fresh issue to one of the listed component versions.
